title: Split the brief-rendering tests out of src/tests/acceptance_evaluation.rs (5,437 lines) and cover the clip's remaining branches
outcome: The pure brief-rendering tests (acceptance_evaluator_brief_*, acceptance_brief_cut_notice_*) with their fixtures live in a sibling test module that shares show_receipt and full_receipt, as a pure move in a commit of its own; and, in a separate commit, the clip is tested on a multibyte body over 600 characters, on a body the marker would not shorten, on an entry both clipped by the host and cut by the tracker, and on a left-out line with more than 64 locators.
acceptance: A test asserts the exact clipped line for a multibyte body over 600 characters, including both byte sizes in the marker.
Tests cover a body over 600 characters that the marker would not shorten, an entry both host-clipped and tracker-cut, and the brief's left-out line with more than 64 locators.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact reviewed tree, its run directory and diff hash cited in a note.
The move is a pure code move in its own commit: no renamed test, no changed assertion; the new file's header says what it owns, what it does not, and the file it was split from.
